neighbours.label: a modifier saying someone actively holds a standing in a faith or role ('practising', 'devout'), as against modifiers that only describe the person
fire: My uncle is a devout Presbyterian.
She remained a practising Jew all her life.
Her cousin is a practicing Hindu.
A pious Buddhist monk crossed the road.
The village has a devout Sikh family.
As a practicing Lutheran, he attends every week.
quiet: My uncle is a friendly Presbyterian.
She remained a shy woman all her life.
Her cousin is a talkative Hindu.
A thin Buddhist monk crossed the road.
The village has a large Sikh family.
As a tall Lutheran, he ducks every week.
